messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm opening a small packet of docs PRs to reshuffle guides and fix a bunch of stale links. 3 PRs: (A) move files from /guides -> /docs/guides, (B) update all internal links + SDK snippets, (C) add redirects + anchor corrections. Need review owners and a merge order. :eyes:
sam: Please post the PR numbers and which one needs to land first. I can hold merges in the window if previews are flaky.
maya: PRs: #4123 (move-files), #4124 (link-updates), #4125 (redirects & anchors). Sequence should be 4123 -> 4124 -> 4125. 4124 touches many pages that will 404 if move hasn't landed.
jon: I'll take #4123 today, can do a quick scan for accidental deletions. ETA EOD. :+1:
carla: I can own #4125 (redirects). Quick note: redirects.yml needs explicit anchor mapping for a few pages (anchors changed during the split). If we only add file-level redirects we'll still break deep links.
zane: Heads-up: docs-preview CI flagged case-sensitivity issues on several filenames (e.g. Guides/GetStarted.md vs guides/getstarted.md). On Linux/CI it's fine but Netlify preview treats paths differently. We should normalize casing in move PR. :warning:
maya: Good catch. I added a tiny script in #4123 to normalize filenames: `scripts/normalize_case.py` — run `python scripts/normalize_case.py --rename` locally. Also I'm generating a mapping file `docs/move-map.json` to help update links in #4124.
sam: docs-bot, can you deploy previews for each PR and post links?
docs-bot: preview deployed for PR #4123: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.net/pr-4123 — build passed.
docs-bot: preview deployed for PR #4124: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.net/pr-4124 — build failed: 12 broken anchors found. See log: `./scripts/linkcheck --format=summary`
maya: Broken anchors sample from the linkcheck output:
```
Broken anchor: /docs/guides/quickstart.md#rate-limits -> target not found (expected /docs/guides/quick-start.md#rate-limits)
Broken anchor: /docs/api/embeddings.md#input-shape -> target not found (actual anchor is #input-shapes)
```
carla: For anchor fixes, please add a small alias block at the top of the target pages to keep old deep links working. Example to add at top:
```
---
aliases:
  - /guides/quickstart#rate-limits
  - /api/embeddings#input-shape
---
```
jon: Suggestion: don't land #4124 until #4123 is merged and CI previews are green. Otherwise lots of 404 spam in the site and we might miss regressions.
sam: Agreed. I'll gate merges — only let #4123 merge once I sign off on the normalized filenames and make preview green.
maya: Also note one tricky edge: some external customers reference deep anchors in support tickets. We should include a short migration note in the release notes and add permanent redirects for anchor-level URLs where possible.
zane: I ran `python scripts/check_links.py --base /docs` locally and it flags 8 remaining anchors after my small fixes. I'll push a follow-up commit to #4124 with alias blocks for the worst offenders.
carla: When I deploy #4125 (redirects), Netlify `_redirects` can't do anchor-level rewrites. We'll need a small client-side snippet on the landing page to read fragment and map it if redirect landed at file-level only. I can add that as fallback in #4125 if maintainers are ok.
sam: Show me the client-side fallback before merge. Keep it minimal and opt-in by page.
maya: Will do. One more CI note: docs-preview only checks anchors after building, so if we rename and update links in separate PRs the preview for the link-update PR will look broken until the move PR is merged — that's expected. We'll rely on the move PR preview to validate the new paths.
jon: I'll prioritize reviewing #4123 now. If it looks good, can we do a staged merge: merge A in morning window, wait 10 mins, then merge B preview branch (but keep it blocked until its own preview passes)?
sam: Yes — I'll coordinate the window and temporarily freeze unrelated doc merges. I'll post a merge freeze message in #release-war-room 10m before.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll add a checklist comment to each PR enumerating required sign-offs and CI checks: normalize-case ✅, preview ✅, linkcheck ✅, docs-bot deploy ✅. :heavy_check_mark:
docs-bot: Note: automated linkcheck can be run with `./scripts/linkcheck --fail-on 1` to fail CI on the first broken link.
carla: OK I'm backing #4125 once alias blocks and client fallback are in. Also will add short migration blurb to /docs/whats-new.
zane: After merges, I'll run a site-wide smoke-check and ping support channels for any reported 404s.
sam: Great. Leave a message here once #4123 is merged. :shipit:
maya: Will do — pinging again when merged.
